
### **Update Hosts File:**

```bash
# Copy contents of portal-hosts-entries.txt to C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts
```

### **Update Vite Configuration:**

```bash
# Copy allowedHosts from vite-allowed-hosts.js to vite.config.ts
```
